summary: Report a stalled run when a worker holds a step and only renews its lease; lease renewals no longer count as a sign of life

replay.detail: No replay or projection changes. The stall deadline is recomputed at each run evaluation from existing step timing and progress claims.

schema.detail: No persisted schema, claim vocabulary or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and retention rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Behaviour change for runs that name a reporter (report-to): a step a live seat holds now stalls after stalled-after (30 minutes unless set) without a work progress record, a new claim or resume, or a declared work wait. Before, the minute-by-minute lease renewal postponed the stall for as long as the seat lived. A worker on a long step should record progress with fractal work progress, or the reporter gets one stalled message per silence. Runs without report-to are unaffected. Members on different builds each evaluate only their own runs, so a mixed fleet reports by the build of the member that owns the run. Not tested against an older build.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout. The stall check adds one indexed step read per held step, only for runs that name a reporter and only when the run is evaluated.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure. To silence stall reports for a run, use report-stalls=#false or fractal missions report-to RUN --report-stalls false. The rule is in docs/st3/mission-graph-runtime.md under Run reports.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores the previous stall clock. Stalled messages already sent stay in the reporter's mailbox.
